takeaways: Study led by Sarah Lessard at Virginia Tech's Fralin Biomedical Research Institute, published February 25, 2026 in Nature Communications

events.updates_title: Virginia Tech Develops Smart Patch for Automatic Naloxone Delivery During Fentanyl Overdose
takeaways: Device smaller than a penny with 121 microneedle tips
Delivers multiple doses over 24-hour lifespan
Nearly 70,000 overdose deaths in U.S. in 2025, over half fentanyl-linked
Currently in testing phase at Virginia Tech

events.title: Iowa Monarch Conservation Consortium deploys technology for migration research
events.one_liner: The Iowa Monarch Conservation Consortium is using new technology and requesting citizen reports to identify monarch rest areas during migration.
events.updates_title: Iowa researchers use citizen science and technology to track monarch butterfly migration

events.title: Study reveals how user bias shapes social media content feeds
events.one_liner: Research shows that social media feeds reflect users' perception bias and desire for content variety, causing ordinary information to be overlooked.

events.title: Michigan Tech Research Award honors data-driven decision-making innovation
events.one_liner: A Michigan Tech award winner has developed sustainable, interdisciplinary research infrastructure to improve data-driven decision-making across campus.
events.updates_title: Michigan Tech researcher wins award for data-driven decision-making and discovery

events.title: Virginia Tech receives $20 million grant for cloud-based semiconductor laboratory
events.one_liner: Virginia Tech has secured a $20 million grant to develop a cloud-based semiconductor laboratory, alongside healthcare-related state and federal grants.
events.updates_title: Virginia Tech Awarded $20 Million Grant for Cloud-Based Semiconductor Laboratory

events.title: Chemical engineering graduate students win inaugural commercialization pitch competition
events.one_liner: Three graduate students won the inaugural Academy of Research Commercialization pitch competition with deep tech startup ideas.
events.updates_title: Chemical Engineering Students Win ARC Pitch Competition for Deep Tech Startup Concepts

events.title: Forrester releases AI Disruption Model analyzing technology market impact
events.one_liner: Tech research firm Forrester has introduced an AI Disruption Model that analyzes how artificial intelligence is transforming technology markets.
events.updates_title: Forrester Unveils AI Disruption Model Analyzing Tech Market Impact

events.title: Isolated AI pilots limit business value in transportation and logistics, says Info-Tech
events.one_liner: Info-Tech Research Group reports that fragmented AI pilot programs in transportation and logistics are preventing organizations from achieving full business value.

events.title: Waste dump landslide in Guinea kills 30 after heavy rainfall
events.one_liner: A landslide at a dump site in Conakry, Guinea killed 30 people following heavy rain, at a location the government had promised to relocate.
events.updates_title: Landslide at Waste Landfill in Guinea Capital Kills at Least 30 People

events.title: Iceland votes on restarting European Union membership negotiations
events.one_liner: Icelanders are voting on whether to resume discussions about joining the European Union, a decision that has divided the nation of 400,000 people.
